chunks: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Fadhl narrated from Ali ibn Asbat from Ala' ibn Razin from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
I asked him about a man who divorces his wife with two divorces, then divorces her a third time while he is ill. He said: 'She inherits him.'
ai.seo_question: Does a wife inherit if her husband divorces her three times before he dies?
ai.summary: In this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), the specific condition of the husband's illness at the time of the third divorce is crucial, as it triggers the ruling of 'deathbed divorce' (marghuniyyah) where the marriage bond remains intact for inheritance purposes. This highlights the Shia jurisprudential distinction that a divorce issued during illness does not fully sever the marital ties until death, thereby preserving the wife's right to inherit from her husband's estate.
